gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: When the default lookup is null and the key has no resolvable prefix, lookup returns null.
ADDED i3: A key whose prefix is the empty string is routed to the lookup registered under "", here an XML encoder, which encodes the remaining text after the colon.
ADDED i4: apply delegates to the default lookup; the XML decoder leaves text without entities unchanged.
ADDED i5: compose returns a function that runs the lookup first and feeds its result to the given function; when that function returns null the composed result is null.
ADDED i6: A key with an unknown prefix falls back to the default lookup, which receives the text after the colon; the XML decoder returns it unchanged.
ADDED i7: The no-argument constructor builds an instance without throwing.
ADDED i8: toString produces a non-null description of the lookup map and default lookup.
ADDED i9: Constructing with a single default lookup also adds all 18 default string lookups to the map.
